items.title: Neal Caine interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019
items.q: But like I remember one time after the Betty Carter gig I was like moping. And she goes, “What’s wrong with you?”

ctx.x: I think I know what you’re saying, because I’ve been fortunate to interview a lot of folks from that generation, and they’re serious. And they’re always dressed up and they’re always a take care of the bandstand type attitude. Why would that change?

I don’t know. I mean I don’t know if it’s a function of our society in general, like we all have Netflix and other things to do. I don’t know, it’s a good question. I mean I’m not saying people aren’t serious about the music now, they are. But like I remember one time after the Betty Carter gig I was like moping. And she goes, “What’s wrong with you?” I said, “I didn’t think I sounded good tonight. I feel bad about it.” She goes, “Good, you should feel bad.” Like, “Good, motherfucker you should feel bad.” Like…
